description: This file defines a mock implementation of the TokenStorageInterface for CSRF tokens, used in unit testing within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to get, set, remove, and check tokens stored in an internal array.

classes.name: ArrayCsrfTokenStorage
classes.description: A mock implementation of the TokenStorageInterface, providing in-memory storage for CSRF tokens for testing purposes.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves a CSRF token by ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores a CSRF token with a specific ID.

methods.name: removeToken
methods.description: Removes a CSRF token by ID and returns it, or null if it does not exist.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if a token exists for the given ID.
